title: Reduce Month-End Close Time: Sales Numbers & Journal Entries
summary: Learn how Blue Onion aids users in uploading revenue and anticipated AR, acts as an independent verifier of sales, and facilitates sales segmentation and tracking of clearing accounts.
body_markdown:
During this webinar, we will demonstrate how Blue Onion supports users in uploading their revenue and anticipated AR. Additionally, we will explore how Blue Onion has acted as an independent verifier of sales for numerous existing customers. Lastly, we will discuss how Blue Onion facilitates the tracking of clearing accounts and the segmentation of sales into various categories.


### Presenters


1. Brian Webb | *VP of Customer Experience* | Blue Onion
